brief:
The one-line core
CAN'T DECIDE GPT is the human-integrated, AI-powered workspace: everything humans manage and run — life, work, people, projects and services — connected, organized and completed with powerful AI help, while the human always stays in control.

2. The 10-second version
You say what you need in normal words. The system pulls in the real services, people, messages, meetings, files and projects you already use; the AI understands the full picture, prepares the work, drafts, schedules and organizes it; and nothing important moves until you approve it. One connected place — for one person, a family, a freelancer, a team, a business or a whole organisation.

3. The core loop (how it actually works)
Your need — you say it in your own words (type or voice).
AI understands — it tells you what it understood and what it plans to do.
Human tools connect — only the allowed calendar, mail, messages, files, people and projects get used.
Work gets prepared — organised, drafted, scheduled, compared, summarised and shown to you.
You approve — sending, booking, signing and paying always wait for your yes.
Completed and recorded — done, logged, and remembered for next time.
4. Human integrations — what it connects
Instead of forcing you into its own apps, it connects the human things you already run:

People & contacts — who is involved, who is waiting on whom.
Email & messages — the ones that need a reply, with drafts ready for your approval.
Calendar & meetings — free-time finding, meeting planning, reminders, next-week reading.
Tasks & reminders — every to-do from every source, in one honest daily list.
Projects & work areas — people, files, tasks and deadlines kept together.
Files & documents — found, named, organised, missing-flagging.
Teams & communication, learning & education, family & personal planning, business & customers, travel & appointments, shopping & household, finance, health, local & official services.
5. Projects — the human + AI project model
Every project is a living, connected thing, not just a folder:

A project holds its people, files, tasks, milestones, deadlines, comments and services in one place.
The AI reads the project and tells you what changed, what's blocked, who's waiting, and the next best action.
It prepares the work (drafts, plans, follow-ups, meeting slots) and surfaces approvals.
Nothing ships without a human — the AI is the workforce, the human is the decision-maker.
Plans control how many projects run at once: up to 3 on the $1,000 plan, up to 5 on the $1,600 plan.
6. Every tool and function
A. The 24-tool command center (the Radial Board)
Executive — the state of the whole life/business on one decision surface.
AI — the provider hub: bring your own keys, route and monitor every model (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Groq…).
AI Worker — the AI task engine: connect AI services and run tasks, dual engine (browser + API).
Automation — design workflows in plain language; AI executes, humans approve.
Memory — persistent system memory: meetings, contracts, notes and decisions, searchable forever.
Performer — describe it, it runs it: one prompt orchestrates every module.
Tasks — task calendar and execution for your AI workforce.
Projects — portfolio health, progress and delivery risk for every project.
Integrations — connect the tools you already run.
Customers / CRM — the global relationship map: health, risk and follow-ups.
Sales — deals, forecasts and revenue operations, tracked automatically.
Marketing — plan, approve, publish and measure every channel.
Attribution — which post drove sales, who to target, how to convert.
Analytics — every metric, one query away, always current.
Reports — revenue, customer, operations and financial reports, audit-ready.
Finance — cash, receivables and risk, reconciled continuously.
Connect — your sites, socials and inboxes linked and managed.
Website — audit, fix, and track search and AI readiness.
Operations — the work queue, tickets, approvals, policies and execution control.
HR — headcount, recruiting, time off and performance.
Security — access controls, permissions and audit integrity.
Admin — organisation, access and platform controls.
Settings — workspace, AI providers, plan and appearance.
Team — members, roles and collaboration.
B. The 18 Business Pro tools (the operator stack)
Shadow Founder — the nightly memo that reviews the business while you sleep.
Competitor Shadow — a watchlist on competitors with change alerts and counter-moves.
Second Brain — the monthly memory-retention interview so nothing important is lost.
Ghost Mode — hands-off automation that runs on its own and leaves a memo of what it did.
Rescue Button — one-tap triage of everything waiting on you, in priority order.
Proof-of-Work (Proof Reel) — the month's wins compiled automatically into a shareable reel.
The Closer — follow-up pushes on deals and invoices that need to land.
The Scheduler — the operating brief for what moved and what needs you.
Bookkeeper Lite — plain-English financial summaries from your live records.
The Recruiter — role briefs, screening questions and a hiring pipeline.
The Negotiator — fair-but-firm draft positions and scripts for any negotiation.
The Researcher — deep-dive structured briefs on any person, market or topic.
Weekly Ops — the Monday-morning operating brief.
Auto-Renegotiate — renewal campaigns for subscriptions, contracts and recurring costs.
Silent Response — calm, composed replies to messages that make you want to react.
Decay Detect — flags relationships and accounts going cold before they vanish.
Root Cause — digs from a symptom to the underlying cause before you act.
Pricing Experiments — A/B pricing ideas with guardrails, tracking and a recommendation.
Consultant Button — instant senior-consultant-level advice on whatever you're facing.
C. The 11 Personal Life tools (the life stack)
Life Admin — renewals, paperwork and the life backlog you keep postponing.
Inbox Triage — inbox zero: triage, prioritise and auto-draft replies.
Money Peace — your finances explained in plain, calm language. No jargon.
Errand Brain — every errand sequenced into one efficient run.
Household — shared home responsibilities kept fair and visible.
The Decision Assistant — structure hard calls instead of looping on them.
Weekly Personal Recap — your week, summarised so you actually remember it.
The Fixer — an annoying thing, a clear resolution: steps and message drafts included.
Second Eyes — a second read of anything before you hit send or sign.
The Nudge — gentle pushes on the thing you keep skipping.
The Buffer — a cool head between you and the message that got to you.
D. The rest of the workspace
Chat & voice assistant, documents, email, templates, summarizer, translator, writing assistant, code & image generators, data analysis, skills & workforce management, notifications, marketplace, mission control, command ("what are we doing today?"), search everything, and the Trust Center.

7. How it's for everyone
One person — your whole life and decisions in one place.
A family — shared plans, errands, household and appointments.
A freelancer — clients, projects, invoices, follow-ups, brand.
A team — tasks, approvals, communication and delivery.
A business — CRM, sales, marketing, finance, HR, ops, analytics, reports.
A larger organisation — teams, workspaces, roles, controls and audit.
8. The guarantee — how you KNOW this is the human helper, not AI taking over
This is what makes it the human-integrated human helper with AI-integrated projects:

You approve the important stuff. Sending, booking, signing and paying are only ever prepared by AI — they wait for your yes.
You choose what connects. Everything is opt-in, per service, per permission.
The AI explains itself. Every recommendation and action shows a reason you can read and challenge.
Transparency by design. Full activity history — you can check what it did, when and why.
Nothing is invisible or permanent. Disconnect any service, change any permission, archive or export your data at any time.
Hard gates where it matters. Money, legal and contract actions are hard-gated; the AI cannot touch them on its own.
It works the human way. It doesn't replace judgement, relationships or decisions — it removes the heavy, repetitive load so humans can do the human parts.

Say what you need, and it connects your people, messages, meetings, files, tasks and projects, prepares the work with powerful AI, and shows the next best action. AI carries the load, you keep control.
